title: Towards Robust Vision-Language Reasoning: A Multi-Stage Optimization Pipeline with Masked Diffusion Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.15238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. translated_title: 迈向鲁棒的视觉-语言推理：基于掩码扩散模型的多阶段优化流程
translated_abstract: 离散扩散生成正成为一种有竞争力的自回归生成替代方案，它通过迭代精炼对整个 token 序列进行去噪。其全局规划与渐进式纠错能力尤其适合自动驾驶。然而，将这种生成范式从通用场景迁移到驾驶场景时，在训练和推理两个阶段都会引入显著的领域差距。为了释放其潜力，我们针对标准视觉-语言模型架构提出了一种多阶段优化流程，无需辅助动作专家模块或专门的专家混合 Transformer，涵盖后训练与推理阶段。在监督微调阶段，我们优化规划输入的表示，以抑制任务响应中的幻觉。在强化学习阶段，我们引入基于指标的多样性过滤，以识别更强的学习起点并改进策略探索/利用……
tldr: 提出了一种无需动作专家或专家混合模块、贯穿后训练与推理的多阶段优化流程，将掩码扩散生成模型成功迁移到自动驾驶的视觉-语言推理中，通过优化规划输入表示抑制幻觉、借助指标引导的多样性过滤强化学习，从而提升推理鲁棒性。
